pages.title: Emberstar Cord Bracelet
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Crafted from 8 Void Emberstars around a single piece of string.$(br2)§lCondition: §r Works while in a Curios slot, or in the main hand / off hand.$(br2)Night Beyond the Campfire: attack speed increased by 50%.$(br)This is my soulless heart: all damage taken is reduced by 25%, gradually rising to 99.9% over playtime.$(br)Hollow Heart: mob detection range reduced by 99%.$(br)Face the Void: falling into the void returns you to your latest respawn point; a bed's spawn takes priority over a respawn anchor.$(br)Your existence is the meaning: when you would take lethal damage, you survive once, restore all health, and gain 30 seconds of invulnerability.
Recipe: 8 Void Emberstars in a ring, with 1 piece of string in the center.
